If I'm seeing what I'm seeing in the picture and there isn't a jumper, the speakers aren't being powered correctly. If you have 2 wires going to each speaker you will need an extra bit to bridge the binding posts. [Notice the gold connection between the upper and lower posts.](https://img.usaudiomart.com/uploads/large/1369118-totem-dreamcatcher-speakers.jpg)

If they're not connected and you're only connecting to the upper or lower sets you will only be powering the tweeter or woofer.

I would assume you connected them to the bottom posts and were only driving the woofer. You would still get most of the frequency range, but you're missing out on the [green line here](https://www.stereophile.com/images/511Totfig03.jpg).
